outcome: maternal complications (pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, cesarean section, thrombocytopenia)
perinatal outcomes (intrauterine growth retardation, preterm birth, APGAR score, neonatal death)
cohort: Pregnant patients with SLE who delivered at Aga Khan University Hospital, Karachi, from January 1998 to December 2019
finding: Planned pregnancy and less severe disease flares during pregnancy are associated with more favorable feto-maternal outcomes in patients with SLE.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was 57.6% in the study cohort.
